messages:
carmen (Marketing): Pushed a new draft to the shared doc at https://docs.example/launch-optimize. Angle: practical launch playbook + bench highlights. Please review short and sharp.
noel (Growth): Quick asks: 1) gate a one-page playbook for MQL capture, 2) agree UTMs + lead property for HubSpot routing.
anya (Product): I'll drop p50/p95/p99 and an example cost calc into the doc later today. Mark as internal bench.
violet (Content): Intro is a bit fluffy. I'll trim to ~60 words and make first line customer benefit-forward. Also proposing a sidebar with the minimal quickstart request.
harry (Sales): Sales needs: standardized lead tag (launch_source=optimize_blog), HubSpot mapping, and a one-slide "how to qualify" for SDRs. Also request company_domain and job_title in the webhook.
noel (Growth): Proposed UTMs: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=optimize_launch&utm_content=playbook. Lead property: launch_source=optimize_blog.
anya (Product): Added bench numbers: p50=30ms, p95=110ms, p99=200ms; approximate cost $0.0019 per 1k tokens on our recommended preset.
carmen (Marketing): I'll attribute those as "internal benchmark (typical workload)".
publish-bot: provisional webinar slot created for 2026-05-20T16:00Z -> https://cal.example/w/launch2026
harry (Sales): Webinar week-after publish works. Sales will co-host partner seats; need CSV export of downloads for outbound. Also want a suggested 2-line follow-up email for SDRs.
violet (Content): Suggested post structure: 1) 1-line problem, 2) playbook steps (routing, caching, quantization, batching), 3) benchmark box, 4) quickstart code block, 5) gated playbook CTA -> webinar. Adding micro-FAQ about compliance.
noel (Growth): Gating rules: when asset downloaded set Lifecycle Stage = marketing qualified and add tag launch_source=optimize_blog. Devs, sample webhook payload below, confirm fields: 
```
POST /webhooks/hubspot
{
  "email":"{{email}}",
  "first_name":"{{first_name}}",
  "company":"{{company}}",
  "company_domain":"{{company_domain}}",
  "job_title":"{{job_title}}",
  "utm_campaign":"optimize_launch",
  "lead_tag":"optimize_blog",
  "model_profile":"{{model_profile}}",
  "asset_type":"pdf",
  "is_partner":"{{is_partner}}"
}
```
anya (Product): model_profile and company_domain are useful for correlating which bench they viewed. Approve.
carmen (Marketing): Adding partner UTM param when relevant. Timeline: lock copy Thursday, assets Friday, publish Tuesday. Copy-lock review Thu 2026-04-16 15:00 in #marketing.
violet (Content): I'll do final edit Thursday morning and push copy-locked version here.
harry (Sales): Sales OK. Please remember to include the rep-facing one-slide and CSV export instructions in /ops/sales-kit.
publish-bot: reminder scheduled for copy-lock review in #marketing on 2026-04-16T15:00Z.
carmen (Marketing): Thanks everyone. I'll post back when copy is locked and drop the HubSpot mapping for final sign-off.
